title: feat(plugin-list): kanban lane-field picker offers lookup, user, master-detail and tree fields

Fixes #36643

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 管理员在看板的「视图设置」里选泳道字段时，现在可以选查找、人员、主从和树形字段了（以前只能选下拉和单选）；能装多个值的引用字段仍然不出现。
- 属于看板按负责人分泳道的那项工作：上一步已经让看板能按引用字段正确画泳道，但界面上选不到，这一步把入口补上。
- 出错的话，管理员会在选项里看到不该出现的字段，或者少看到该出现的；只影响看板设置菜单，撤回这次改动即可恢复。
- 无

## What changes
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the `laneFieldOptions` filter now offers, besides `select` / `radio`, any field whose type is in `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` (`lookup`, `user`, `master_detail`, `tree`; the `@object-ui/core` set ListView already imports) and whose definition is not `multiple: true`. The comment that said reference lanes are not drawn yet is rewritten: since the merged reference-lane work, the board keys such a lane by the foreign key and titles it by name.
- No second type list: `kanbanReferenceLanes.ts` exports `laneKeyOf` / `lanesFromRecords` / `laneValueOf` only, no type predicate, and plugin-list does not depend on plugin-kanban; the board itself decides reference lanes from the record value, and `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` is the set the board's `$expand` reads, so the picker offers exactly the fields whose values the board receives expanded.
- Test: `ListView.kanbanSettings-36370.test.tsx` now pins the offered set (stage, tier, account, owner, parent, region) and the refused set (a multi-valued lookup, a multi-valued user, a boolean, text, currency), and that choosing `owner` writes `{ groupByField: 'owner', lanes: null }`.

## Tests
Local, at head `86a26e3`:
- `vitest run` on `ListView.kanbanSettings-36370.test.tsx` and `ViewSettingsPopover.kanban-36370.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 10 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Ablation (source-resolved, same package, no build): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the EXPANDABLE branch of the filter with `return false;` (anchor x1 -> x0): 2 failed / 2 passed, the two new pins red. Restore blob `b37e4b9d` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The `multiple !== true` guard is defence-in-depth (the group options already drop multi-valued fields), so it is not claimed as pinned by an ablation.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check`: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes
- Third acceptance line (owner field gives one lane per owner, a drag changes the owner): the picker writes `groupByField: 'owner'` (pinned here); the board's behaviour on that `groupBy` is the merged reference-lane work, pinned by `ObjectKanban.referenceLanes-36430.test.tsx`. Not re-driven in a browser in this PR.
- Optional `swimlaneField` sibling NOT taken: it is not the same `laneKeyOf` reuse. `KanbanImpl.tsx` stringifies `card[swimlaneField]` in two places (row keys ~1381, cell bucketing ~1774), uses the key as the row heading, sorts by it, and `useCrossSwimlaneMove.ts` writes the row key back. Swapping in `laneKeyOf` would turn `[object Object]` headings into raw ids; a correct fix also needs name titles and the expanded write-back value, so it wants a card of its own.

## Verification
- First file to read: the `laneFieldOptions` hunk in `ListView.tsx`.
- Two-minute check: on a board view, open 视图设置 → lane field; Owner and Account appear next to Stage; pick Owner and the board redraws one lane per owner.
